personal.name: Anmol Goel
personal.tagline: Building the Future at the Intersection of AI & Biotechnology
personal.current_status: B.Tech in Biochemical Engineering & Biotechnology, IIT Delhi · Biotech × AI builder

about: I build at the intersection of biotechnology and AI: bioprocess modelling and molecular simulation on one side, AI agents and developer tools on the other. At IIT Delhi I ranked first in my department, won silver at iGEM Paris, and built defence and industry tools ranging from terrain-adaptive camouflage for the Indian Army to ML for surfactant stability at HUL R&D. Lately I've been shipping open-source tools: an MCP server that lets AI agents work in Jupyter notebooks, an offline document redaction engine, and a Python port of the IndPenSim penicillin fermentation simulator.

experience.description: Developed E2E solution for Surfactant Stability. Reduced testing time from 84 days to hours. Consolidated 300k+ records and trained ML models (RF/XGB/LightGBM) with R²=0.75.
Developed Terrain Adaptive Camouflage & Concealment Software using K-means clustering and OpenCV. Received formal LoR.
Leading a 5-member team to develop ESG reporting solutions. Reduced heuristic requirement time by 75%.
Capsule Endoscopy Tracking. Achieved 91.75% accuracy in disease classification on Kvasir Dataset.
